titles: parses the 96-byte EA3 header with bounded reads and serves stereo 44100 Hz s16be from offset 96
refuses OMA headers in native order with native statuses and unported codecs, tags and partial frames explicitly
ports oma_read_probe and ff_id3v2_match over the bytes native inspects
aborts OMA opens and packet reads on the signal
registers a demux-only oma descriptor detected by EA3 with a six-byte confirm, 256-sample packets and an input-seek refusal
matches native OMA LPCM copy and decode framecrc, wav, raw s16be and aiff outputs for whole-packet payloads and refuses copy of a short final packet
matches native OMA output -ss, -t and -frames selections for copy and decode
mirrors native OMA statuses for truncated, non-EA3, encrypted and unknown-codec headers and refuses ATRAC3, ea3 tags and input seeks before any output

nativeComparisons.copyShortTailRefusals: 12 native -c copy runs of short tails (native framecrc ends in F=0x3), refused by EdgeFFmpeg with no output
nativeComparisons.statusChecks: 12: truncated header 255, bad EA3 under -f oma 183, eid 0x0001 and 0xFF7F 255, codec ids 5 and 99 host ENOSYS vs Linux 218, each for decode and copy
nativeComparisons.nativeAcceptance: 4: ATRAC3 codec id 0 (framecrc header atrac3), ea3-tagged file (pcm_s16be), input -ss; all refused by EdgeFFmpeg before output

unsupported: codec ids 0 ATRAC3, 1 ATRAC3+, 2 AAC, 3 MP3, 33 ATRAC3+ AL, 34 ATRAC3 AL: native demuxes, refused
leading ID3v2 ea3 tag: native skips it and exports metadata and chapters, refused
encrypted files: mirrored only for untagged files (native 255 without a GEOB tag)
-c copy of a payload that is not whole 1024-byte packets (native flags the short final packet CORRUPT): refused through info.copyRefusal; decoding matches native

notes: Node 24.22.3 was installed with `npx n 24` (about 7 s); the sandbox default was Node v22.23.5, which npm run bootstrap refuses.
Setup: npm run bootstrap -- --only npm,submodule,reference --allow-unpinned-reference took 4 min 40 s (npm 11.7 s, submodule 8.9 s, reference build about 4 min 20 s on 4 vCPUs).
Baseline before changes: typecheck, lint, boundaries and the container registry unit tests passed (about 1 min 33 s).

Native probes in the sandbox confirmed 256-sample, 1024-byte rows with no flag column for whole packets and F=0x3 on the short final packet under -c copy, and 'No encryption header found' with status 255 for an encrypted eid without a tag.
The truncated-header and encrypted statuses are a literal -1 (255) and the bad EA3 header is AVERROR_INVALIDDATA (183), all host-independent; only ENOSYS depends on the host errno.
The differential file runs in about 4 s on the sandbox (4 vCPUs).
